# Systematic: features of candidate in-band empty positions; find feature selecting demo fills
demos = [
 dict(P={(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(3,0),(3,1)}, n=4, m=4, strip_axis='band', strip=1, fill=(1,1)),
 dict(P={(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(2,1)}, n=3, m=3, strip_axis='col', strip=2, fill=(1,2)),
 dict(P={(0,0),(1,1),(2,0),(2,1)}, n=3, m=3, strip_axis='col', strip=2, fill=(0,2)),
]
Mcells = [ {(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,1),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(3,0),(3,1)},
           {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,2),(2,1)},
           {(0,0),(0,2),(1,1),(2,0),(2,1)} ]
satcells = [ set(), {(1,2),(2,1)}, {(0,0),(0,2)} ]
def feats(P,n,m,strip_axis,strip,p,M,S):
    b,s=p
    Pp = P|{p}
    def rowc(q): return sum(1 for x in Pp if x[0]==q)
    def colc(q): return sum(1 for x in Pp if x[1]==q)
    def chain(seq): 
        # longest contiguous run of positions in seq
        l=0;best=0
        for i in range(-6,7):
            l = l+1 if (i in seq) else 0
            best=max(best,l)
        return best
    dchain = chain({x[0]-x[1] for x in Pp if x[0]-x[1]==b-s}) if False else max((sum(1 for x in Pp if x[0]-x[1]==b-s)),0)
    f={}
    f['rowc']=rowc(b); f['colc']=colc(s)
    f['rowc_eq_colc']=int(rowc(b)==colc(s))
    f['orth']=sum(((b+1,s) in P,(b-1,s) in P,(b,s+1) in P,(b,s-1) in P))
    f['diag']=sum(((b+1,s+1) in P,(b+1,s-1) in P,(b-1,s+1) in P,(b-1,s-1) in P))
    f['ddiag']=f['diag']-f['orth']
    f['inM']=int(p in M); f['inSat']=int(p in S)
    f['dchain']=sum(1 for x in Pp if x[0]-x[1]==b-s)
    f['achain']=sum(1 for x in Pp if x[0]+x[1]==b+s)
    f['row_complete']=int(rowc(b)==m)
    f['col_complete']=int(colc(s)==n)
    f['rowc_max']=int(rowc(b)==max(rowc(i) for i in range(n)))
    f['colc_max']=int(colc(s)==max(colc(j) for j in range(m)))
    f['rowc_min']=int(rowc(b)==min(rowc(i) for i in range(n)))
    f['colc_min']=int(colc(s)==min(colc(j) for j in range(m)))
    f['dist2']=int(f['orth']==0 and f['diag']>0)
    f['dist3']=int(f['orth']==0 and f['diag']==0)
    # transpose-symmetry repair: p needed so that Pp symmetric?
    sym = all(((x[1],x[0]) in Pp) for x in Pp)
    f['makes_sym']=int(sym)
    f['p_needed_sym']=int(not all(((x[1],x[0]) in P) for x in P) and sym)
    f['b_eq_s']=int(b==s)
    return f
# candidates per demo = empty in-strip positions
for i,d in enumerate(demos):
    print('--- demo',i+1,'fill',d['fill'])
    cands=[]
    if d['strip_axis']=='band': cands=[(d['strip'],s) for s in range(d['m'])]
    else: cands=[(b,d['strip']) for b in range(d['n'])]
    for p in cands:
        if p in d['P']: continue
        F=feats(d['P'],d['n'],d['m'],d['strip_axis'],d['strip'],p,Mcells[i],satcells[i])
        print(p, {k:v for k,v in F.items() if v})
